case_goal: Verify that a user can edit their profile successfully in Admidio.
summary: The test navigates to the user profile edit page, modifies profile fields (e.g., first name, last name), saves changes, and confirms the updates are reflected.

steps.expected_result: User profile edit page is displayed.
First name field shows the entered text.
Last name field shows the entered text.
Changes are saved and a success message is displayed.
Profile page shows updated first and last name.
